tasks.title: Fix summary Excel export download
tasks.about: Exporting the summary Excel table fails in the browser (Chrome: site was not available). Screenshots show Summary of Systems Export Summary and failed subsections_summary_*.xlsx files.

tasks.title: Auto-fill invoice date from signed approved PDF
tasks.about: When Read Approved Signed QTY imports a signed PDF, automatically update Invoice Date for Approved Signed QTY (screenshot also marks invoice numbers and submitted date — confirm extra fields with client).

tasks.title: Click item number to navigate BOQ ↔ Concentration
tasks.about: Keep View Sheet in Actions, and also let clicking section/item number on BOQ open that Concentration sheet, and clicking item number on Concentration go back to BOQ.

tasks.title: Split FATINA vs FATINA INVOICE folders
tasks.about: Calc-sheet folders (e.g. 17_1) and invoice folders (e.g. 03_m) currently mix under C:\Fatina\{item}. Use two parent folders such as FATINA and FATINA INVOICE.

tasks.title: Color unmatched quantities on Concentration sheets
tasks.about: Color entry text (e.g. red) when approved qty does not match submitted qty, or when it does not match estimated qty. Give the user both options to choose.

tasks.title: Track calculation sheet directly from Concentration
tasks.about: Opening a calc sheet from Concentration already works. Tracking currently requires going to Calculation Sheets, searching the number, then Track. Add a direct track path.

tasks.title: Word search on Concentration item list
tasks.about: Search by words in Work Description and Description, and filter the left item list to items that contain that word.

tasks.title: Hide columns on Concentration Sheets
tasks.about: Allow hiding columns on Concentration Sheets for convenience. No dedicated screenshot.

tasks.title: Hebrew titles for updated contract columns
tasks.about: After Update Contract Quantity, Hebrew UI still shows English titles such as UPDATED CONTRACT QTY 1 / UPDATED CONTRACT SUM 1. Use כמות חוזה מעודכנת מס' 1 and סה"כ חוזה מעודכן מס' 1.

tasks.title: Updated Qty badge only when quantity actually changed
tasks.about: Show Updated Qty only when the new quantity differs from the previous update, not vs original forever. Example: 200→250 show; 250→250 do not show.

tasks.title: In-app calculator side panel
tasks.about: Add a calculator (like Windows Calculator) that can be opened from any sheet.

tasks.title: Column resize sliders on more tables
tasks.about: Concentration Sheets already has sliders. Add the same to Concentration window and other tables if possible: Project Info Files, List of Drawings, BOQ Items.

tasks.title: Allow spontaneous captions on calc sheet upload
tasks.about: Uploading a calc sheet fails if line 2 is a free-text caption: Value must be either numerical or a string containing a wildcard. Allow any spontaneous caption.

tasks.title: Changing calc sheet invoice number must keep totals correct
tasks.about: If a calc sheet is set to Invoice 06 then later changed to 07, totals become wrong. User currently must delete and re-upload. Update should work without that.

tasks.title: FATINA invoice folder must stay per item
tasks.about: If one calc sheet has item X as Invoice 07 and item Y as Invoice 06 (example: 1.51.02.0020 = 07 and 1.51.02.0030 = 05/01-06), item Y's Fatina folder must not get 07_m.

tasks.title: Keep PDFs when updating an existing calc sheet
tasks.about: Updating a calculation sheet that already has PDFs attached currently deletes all PDFs. Attachments should remain unless the user deletes them.

tasks.title: Three digits after the decimal point
tasks.about: Quantities currently keep 5+ decimals internally (e.g. 146.09015 shown as 146.09). Client wants 3 digits after the decimal.
